basic_info.description: Spacious TOP floor 2 bedroom/2.5 bathrooms tri-level loft/condo with City VIEWS from ALL floors, located in PRIME Media Gulch portion of Mission, adjacent to Flour & Water Restaurant & within block(s) of corporate shuttles, transportation & neighborhood commercial. Unit has vaulted ceiling, skylights, maple hardwood floors, 2 FPLs, updated kitchen/baths, large closets with custom built-ins, walk-out balcony, 2 separate entrances & exclusive 1-car parking space in common garage area.
